summary: Epic's PC platformers, with the sequel's expansions and modern source reimplementation kept together.

entries.title: Jazz Jackrabbit 2
entries.definitive_edition: GOG Jazz Jackrabbit 2 Collection plus Jazz² Resurrection

emulation.notes: Requires legally obtained original data; use the GOG collection as the source.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native widescreen, pixel-perfect scaling, and unlocked frame rate without DirectDraw-era compatibility problems.

primary.version: GOG Jazz Jackrabbit 2 Collection data in Jazz² Resurrection
primary.why: The GOG collection supplies the DRM-free base game, The Secret Files, and The Christmas Chronicles; Jazz² Resurrection imports those original assets into a maintained native engine with modern Windows support, native widescreen, pixel-perfect scaling, and unlocked frame rates.
primary.how_to_play: Install the GOG collection, copy its original data into the current Jazz² Resurrection release, and import the extra episodes from the menu. Use pixel-perfect scaling and a frame-rate setting that does not speed up game logic.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original-engine behavior and fuller JJ2+ compatibility where the reimplementation still differs.
secondary.what_to_play: Keep the GOG v1.24 executable with the current JJ2+ distribution as a fallback for incompatible custom levels or multiplayer features.
secondary.why: Jazz² Resurrection is a reimplementation and documents only partial support for some JJ2+ and MLLE features.

all_releases.fidelity: Original DirectDraw engine with bundled level editor.
all_releases.reason: skip as the main route: modern fullscreen performance and resolution problems require patches or a replacement engine.

all_releases.fidelity: Contemporary Mac port without the Jazz Creation Station editor.
all_releases.reason: skip: no content or modern-access advantage over the Windows collection.

all_releases.fidelity: Adds Lori and a nine-level episode across three zones.
all_releases.reason: primary package component: required expansion content included by GOG.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced Holiday Hare '98 content on The Secret Files engine with Lori.
all_releases.reason: primary package component: included by GOG and supersedes the earlier holiday release for this route.

all_releases.fidelity: DRM-free complete data with a modern native engine, widescreen, pixel-perfect scaling, and unlocked frame rates.
all_releases.reason: primary: best combination of sold content and modern presentation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Jazz² Resurrection has the best modern display and OS support, but it is a reimplementation and only partially supports some JJ2+/MLLE features. Keep the patched original engine for edge cases rather than pretending either route is a perfect superset.

entries.remaster_caveats: There is no official remaster. Jazz² Resurrection rewrites the engine while requiring original game data; test custom levels and competitive multiplayer against JJ2+ when exact original-engine behavior matters.
